content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Termination
content_blocks.text: WHEREAS, Tenant has failed to pay rent within the time period required by the Lease Agreement, and

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Effective_Date
content_blocks.text: THEREFORE, this Notice of Termination is given to inform Tenant that the lease will terminate effective March 25, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Eviction_Procedures
content_blocks.text: Tenant shall vacate the premises within ten (10) days of the date of receipt of this Notice of Termination.
